frozen_manifest_unit.title: qFit support-lineage and model-input distinction
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Identify model parentage and experimental-input relationships without treating a generated multiconformer as independently supported.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Can qFit's model-input and generated-multiconformer relationships be recorded as candidate support lineage without treating output conformers as independently supported?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Wankowicz et al. (2023), Automated multiconformer model building for X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM, eLife 12:RP90606.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: qFit multiconformer model building from X-ray/cryo-EM data.

exact_pdf_locators.locator: PDF p. 2, Results, 'Overview of qFit protein algorithm'
exact_pdf_locators.scope: refined single-conformer structure and high-resolution density-map inputs; stated limits for cryo-EM application.

source_objects.native_observable: High-resolution X-ray or cryo-EM density map and a refined single-conformer structural model as method inputs.
source_objects.estimand: Parsimonious multiconformer model that represents heterogeneity in density information.
source_objects.statistical_unit: A structural model/map input and generated alternative conformations per residue/system.
source_objects.spatial_support: Residues, side chains, backbone positions, and density-map features.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: Conformational heterogeneity is represented by discrete alternative conformations rather than a dynamic time series.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: qFit samples conformations and uses optimization/information criteria; cryo-EM use is described as exploratory where map/model metrics develop.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: Generated conformers inherit input/map and modeling assumptions and are not independently sourced observations.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The paper presents automated multiconformer building for X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM.
The Results overview names a refined single-conformer structure and high-resolution map as inputs and calls cryo-EM use exploratory in this context.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is a candidate support-lineage challenge that preserves input/output parentage without asserting a support conclusion.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The source supports recording that qFit output is generated from a refined model and map under stated assumptions.
forbidden_generalizations: Treat generated multiconformers as independent experimental source records.
Treat exploratory cryo-EM use as a general validation outcome.
missing_information: No executable F05 support-lineage conclusion is authorized.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Keep output/model support separate from independent validation.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

support_lineage.generator_or_parentage: refined single-conformer model plus high-resolution map processed by qFit

frozen_pattern_pass_b.first_blocking_dependency: No executable F05 support contract exists.
frozen_pattern_pass_b.local_claim_ceiling: Support-lineage facts only; no candidate-support conclusion.
irrelevant_obligations: No new model or execution action occurs.

analyst_divergence_classification_before.claim_boundary: The analyst records a projection, not a RuleResult or scientific conclusion.

defects.evidence_gap: The listed locators support qFit as a multiconformer-building method using a refined single-conformer model and high-resolution map, with exploratory cryo-EM use; no additional evidence is needed for the frozen lineage-only recording.
defects.dependency_or_route_issue: The candidate-map-only dependency, unresolved status, and HUMAN_OR_NEW_DATA route correctly prevent executable support evaluation or automatic operator routing.
defects.claim_ceiling_consequence: The ceiling remains limited to support-lineage facts and does not assert independent experimental support, reliability, or scientific support.

smallest_candidate_repair.description: No repair is warranted; retain the frozen source-scoped lineage record and claim ceiling.

critic_review.summary: The permitted abstract and overview locators support recording qFit output as generated from a refined single-conformer model and high-resolution map under stated assumptions. The frozen SOURCE binding, candidate-map-only dependency, unresolved status, HUMAN_OR_NEW_DATA route, and lineage-only claim ceiling correctly avoid treating generated conformers as independently supported.
